description: Governed observation of the task package: the three-clause specification text of joinspec.md, the one-line implementation joiner.py (', '.join(reversed(items))), and the six probes of probes.json (two singletons, one empty list, three multi-item lists). Identified Q3 as the isolation-requiring distinction: E-B's authorship condition is already violated by this session having read joiner.py.

E-A statement: enumeration of every behavior exercised by the probe set (empty list, singleton, separator, multi-item ordering) with an explicit argument that joinspec.md determines a unique output for all six probes (no undetermined behaviors), and a per-probe table showing the spec-determined output differs from joiner.py exactly on the multi-item ordering behavior, sorted probe indices [1, 3, 5].

Proposed child bundle for the clean-room implementer: attenuated child contract within child-envelope.json, four-node child harness, standalone child prompt, input manifest restricted to package/artifacts/joinspec.md (excluding joiner.py, probes.json, and all in-session analysis, satisfying E-B's authorship-isolation condition), and a pre-committed deterministic integration rule mapping the child's join_impl.py to the final verdict and divergent_probe_indices.
